subject: zoology
question_text: From which substances 'Smack' and 'Coke' are obtained?

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Fastrack zoology section (book p.59, VSAQ 143). Zoology holds only ONE source book — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no zoology board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the back-test are both structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. ADDED BEYOND THE BOOK: the book prints only 'Coke (Crack) is obtained from Cocaine'; the source plant of cocaine (Erythroxylum coca) and the source plant of morphine (Papaver somniferum) are standard NCERT and are added here.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Smack
lines: Smack is another name for heroin.
It is obtained by the acetylation of morphine,
and morphine comes from the poppy plant Papaver
steps.why: The question asks what each street name is made FROM, so the answer traces smack back one step to morphine and one more step to the plant.
common_mistakes: Writing that smack is obtained from the poppy plant directly. It is made from morphine by acetylation.
steps.memory_tip: Smack is heroin, and heroin is morphine with acetyl added.
steps.margin_note: Two lines: the other name, then the substance it is made from.

steps.label: Coke

lines.text: Smack from morphine, coke from cocaine

lines: Coke, also called crack, is obtained from
Cocaine is obtained from the coca plant,
steps.why: Coke is one step from cocaine and cocaine one step from its plant, which is the same two-step shape as the smack answer and is easy to remember as a pair.
common_mistakes: Writing that coke comes from the poppy plant. That is the source of morphine.
Writing that cocaine and cannabis are the same. They come from different plants.
steps.memory_tip: Two names, two plants: smack from poppy through morphine, coke from coca through cocaine.
steps.margin_note: Two lines. Name the plant if you can; the substance alone earns the mark.

insider_note: Both street names carry a mark each, so answer them separately and do not merge them into one sentence.
